name: print-social-something-we-call-fashion-post-navy-panel-and-orange-tiles
title: 'Some-Thing We Call Fashion.' post with a navy panel, white-washed photo and orange and navy edge tiles
whatItIs: A square post with a photo of a smiling man in a blue blazer, partly washed in white, a tall navy panel with an orange dash and a hyphenated headline 'Some-Thing We Call Fashion.', an orange 'SHOPNOW!' tab, and small orange, navy and white rectangles scattered along the edges like a mosaic.
whatItMeans: Sharp and structured; edge tiles give the post a modular, architectural rhythm.
techniques: Break a word with a hyphen for a stylised headline.
Scatter rectangles along the frame edge.
Wash part of the photo in white.
Match the panel colour to the outfit.

vocabulary.definition: A translucent white overlay fading an image.
